name: EuroOffice
description: Unofficial EuroOffice integration: edit office documents in Mattermost

settings_schema.header:
**EuroOffice Docs**
Open, edit, and co-author office documents in Mattermost chats.
settings_schema.footer: EuroOffice — суверенный офисный пакет (форк ONLYOFFICE DocumentServer).

settings.help_text: EuroOffice Docs Location specifies the address of the server with the document services installed. Please change the '<documentserver>' for the server address in the below line.
Use the auto-generated JWT secret key or set your own here and the same one in the EuroOffice Docs config file.
When enabled, loopback and private-network addresses are allowed. When disabled (default), those destinations are rejected.

settings.display_name: Connection to demo EuroOffice Docs server enabled:

settings.help_text: When enabled, only file owners can protect/unprotect files via the Protection tab. When disabled, file protection is available to everyone.
When enabled, users can access the plugins in the editors. When disabled, the plugins are hidden.
When enabled, users can create and run macros in the editors. When disabled, all macro functionality is hidden.
When enabled, system admins will receive direct messages when the plugin detects an unhealthy Document Server state.
